description: A glowing amber-gold gem sits in an open wooden chest-of-drawers drawer, lit by a candle on the dresser. Beside it are a mirror, a glass bottle and a bowl. Behind, a dark bed with pillows and a curtain, with a shadowy figure's arm reaching across the bedcover on the right. The style is a dark oil painting. The scene is a shadowed bedroom with 19th-century furniture. No visible text, frame or border.
